cases.description: Drops an unused ESM declaration while retaining the imported binding.
cases.title: Unused named export

cases.description: Drops an unused default declaration when a sibling named export is consumed.
cases.title: Unused default export

cases.description: Propagates used exports through two side-effect-free barrels.
cases.title: Star re-export chain

cases.description: Narrows a namespace import to one statically accessed export.
cases.title: Static namespace member

cases.description: Retains the full namespace when the accessed export name is only known at runtime.
cases.title: Dynamic namespace key bailout

cases.description: Keeps explicit export priority while pruning losing and unrelated star exports.
cases.title: Explicit export wins over star conflicts

cases.description: Preserves a live binding through a cycle without retaining an unrelated export.
cases.title: Circular live binding

cases.description: Honors a package contract that declares every module side-effect-free.
cases.title: sideEffects false removes a bare import

cases.description: Preserves package initialization when package metadata marks it effectful.
cases.title: sideEffects true keeps a bare import

cases.description: Drops a pure subpath and retains a subpath matched by the sideEffects array.
cases.title: sideEffects array selects effectful files

cases.description: Skips a side-effect-free barrel and narrows the leaf exports.
cases.title: Side-effect-free re-export passthrough

cases.description: Deduplicates a shared dependency and preserves deterministic evaluation order.
cases.title: Diamond graph side-effect order

cases.description: Narrows a dynamically imported namespace through a destructured binding.
cases.title: Dynamic import destructuring

cases.description: Narrows a dynamically imported namespace through direct member access.
cases.title: Dynamic import member access

cases.description: Tracks a used export through assignment-form destructuring.
cases.title: Dynamic import destructuring assignment

cases.description: Removes a dynamic import that is only reachable from an unused local function.
cases.title: Unused dynamic import chunk

cases.description: Removes one pure declarator without dropping its used sibling.
cases.title: Unused multi-declarator binding

cases.description: Removes a statically unreachable branch.
cases.title: Dead if branch

cases.description: Removes an unused class whose static block has no observable effect.
cases.title: Pure class static block

cases.description: Retains static initialization even when the class binding is unused.
cases.title: Effectful class static block

cases.description: Drops an unused argument whose evaluation is pure.
cases.title: Excess pure argument

cases.description: Preserves evaluation of an unused argument when it has a side effect.
cases.title: Excess effectful argument

cases.description: Drops a pure property when only a sibling property is read.
cases.title: Local object unused property

cases.description: Propagates the set of read properties from a known callee back to its object argument.
cases.title: Object path through function parameter

cases.description: Keeps only properties selected by a destructured function parameter.
cases.title: Object path through destructured parameter

cases.description: Tracks a nested property read and removes an unused sibling path.
cases.title: Nested object property path

cases.description: Removes an unused pure array element when only a fixed index is observed.
cases.title: Known array element path

cases.description: Preserves a getter invocation while allowing an unrelated pure property to disappear.
cases.title: Getter read side effect

cases.description: Retains all properties once an object escapes to an unknown consumer.
cases.title: Object escape bailout

cases.description: Drops an unused annotated call and the now-unreferenced callee.
cases.title: PURE call annotation

cases.description: Drops an unused annotated constructor call and class body.
cases.title: PURE constructor annotation

cases.description: Drops pure call/new bodies but consumes each spread argument in source order.
cases.title: PURE call preserves spread iteration

cases.description: Uses a declaration annotation to remove an otherwise opaque unused call.
cases.title: NO_SIDE_EFFECTS function annotation

cases.description: Keeps a local binding that is only referenced by direct eval.
cases.title: Direct eval scope bailout

cases.description: Narrows a CommonJS namespace through a statically accessed member.
cases.title: CommonJS require member

cases.description: Narrows CommonJS exports through a destructured require binding.
cases.title: CommonJS require destructuring

cases.description: Drops an unused property from a module.exports object literal.
cases.title: CommonJS object-literal export

cases.description: Drops an unused object-export method and the dependency reachable only from its body.
cases.title: Unused CommonJS method disconnects nested require

cases.description: Disconnects a bare require when package metadata declares the target side-effect-free.
cases.title: Unused side-effect-free require

cases.description: Keeps a require whose target has an observable initialization effect.
cases.title: Unused effectful require

cases.description: Propagates a member use through two CommonJS re-export layers.
cases.title: CommonJS deep re-export

cases.description: Retains the selected JSON property and removes an unused pure sibling value.
cases.title: Unused JSON key
